tricks.name: BB - 180 Drill 1
tricks.description: 180 Drill 1 - Slower than normal boat speed. Stay between the wakes.  Starting your toes near one wake, edge on your heels towards the other. Halfway across complete a heelside surface 180 pushing your back hip towards the handle, keeping both hands on the handle.  When you get to the second wake, initiate a turn back, flatten off then repeat the process switch

tricks.name: BB - 360 Drill 1
tricks.description: 360 Drill 1 - Slower than normal boat speed. Stay between the wakes.  Starting your toes near one wake, edge on your heels towards the other. Halfway across complete a heelside surface 360 pushing your back hip towards the handle, keeping both hands on the handle as long as possible and continuing the rotation.  When you get to the second wake, initiate a turn back, flatten off and edge back on your toes.  Carry on back to the starting position and repeat.  Or add in a toeside surface 360 on your way back too. Do that whole drill switch too.

BB - Switch landing drill
tricks.description: BB - Switch landing drill - stay switch for the whole drill. As you edge from inside of the wake to the outside, focus on your position, keeping the weight over the board and the board on edge as you move away from the wakes.  Edge out no more than 3 - 4m.  Combine this with a line of floaty one wake switch jumps.

tricks.name: BB - Toeside edging drill
tricks.description: Stay the side of the wakes you are for a normal foot forward heelside jump. Stay normal foot forwards.  Edge out in a strong toeside position, flatten off, edge back in on your heels to the wake, turn and flatten off. Repeat.

tricks.name: Switch Toeside Backroll to Normal
tricks.description:
Switch Toeside Backroll with a Frontside 180 landing Normal Foot Forward.

This is the Switch version of the Toeside Backroll to Revert. The term ‘Revert’ originated in Skateboarding and is not applied consistently in that sport, so to be clear here we have said ‘to Normal’ meaning landing ‘Normal Foot Forward’. 

And whilst the Switch version of the Heelside Backroll is a Half Cab Roll we have not seen Toeside tricks from Normal to  Switch referred to as Half Cabs.
